result.title: Test-Time Scaling of Text-to-Image Flow Matching Models with Noise-Rejuvenated Sequential Monte Carlo
result.summary: Test-time scaling of diffusion models with sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) has become a promising strategy for sampling under user-specified rewards, such as human preference scores. However, the standard SMC framework typically relies on stochastic proposals and therefore does not directly transfer to flow matching models, in which inference is governed by deterministic ODEs. In this work, we introduce noise-rejuvenated SMC, an inference-time scaling method tailored for text-to-image flow matching models. Our key idea is to perturb each resampled particle by changing its source noise and constructing a new intermediate state using its current endpoint estimate. This moves the particle to another state that remains representable under the flow-matching interpolation form, enabling particle exploration without converting the sampler to an SDE. We further introduce a look-ahead mechanism to refine resampled particles before weighting. Experiments on Stable Diffusion 3, FLUX.1-dev, and Z-Image demonstrate consistent improvements in reward-guided generation, while ablation studies validate the contributions of noise rejuvenation and look-ahead refinement. Code is available at https://github.com/shermanlian/NR-SMC.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文为文生图 flow matching 模型提出 noise-rejuvenated SMC 的推理期扩展方法：通过改变重采样粒子的源噪声并用当前终点估计构造新的中间状态，配合 look-ahead 机制在加权前精化粒子，在 SD3、FLUX.1-dev 等上验证奖励引导生成的稳定提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 粒子重采样、源噪声扰动与 look-ahead 精化可为 LVR 中 latent 假设的候选维护、重采样与验证提供概念线索，但其面向确定性 ODE 的图像生成，迁移到推理状态搜索的可行性需人工核查。
